items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Matches Washington with six carries
items.text:
Jeanty rushed six times for 25 yards while catching five of seven targets for minus-5 yards in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Picked off three times in Week 9 loss
items.text:
Cousins completed 22 of 32 passes for 216 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed twice for no gain and scored a rushing touchdown.

items.title: Michael Wilson: Paces Cardinals in receiving

items.title: Nico Collins: First TD since Week 4 on Sunday

items.title: Brock Purdy: Three total TDs in Week 9 win
items.text:
